labels.Lỗi biên dịch: A real syntax or type error stops compilation (missing semicolon or brace, undeclared variable, wrong return statement, misspelled keyword). Trust compile_log: if it says the file compiled, the answer is No.
labels.Lỗi nhập/xuất: Input is read wrongly or output is not in the required format: wrong words or case (TRUE instead of True), missing or extra values, wrong separators or spacing, wrong file reading. An input prompt such as "Input n: " before the answer is NOT an error for this teacher. A wrong computed value alone is not this error.
labels.Lỗi logic: A wrong condition, formula, comparison or branch inside an otherwise reasonable approach, so some results are wrong.
labels.Lỗi vòng lặp: A loop bound, start, update or stop condition is wrong: off-by-one, a skipped first or last element, an infinite loop because the loop variable or list pointer is never advanced (no cur = cur->next), or a value accumulated inside a loop that ends up wrong (a sum that grows far too large).
labels.Lỗi mảng/chuỗi: Wrong index, out-of-bounds access, wrong string or array handling (wrong substring, wrong character access, wrong concatenation), or returning a pointer to a local array.
labels.Lỗi hàm: The bug sits in a function: a helper function that computes the wrong value (for example a power or product helper), a wrong call or wrong arguments, a missing return value, a required function missing or with a changed prototype (the test driver cannot build it), or library conversion functions misused (stoi/stof on text that is not a number).
labels.Lỗi edge case: The main cases work but boundary inputs fail: smallest or largest values, empty input, a single element, all values equal, negative numbers, or a special case the statement mentions. Typical evidence: normal tests pass while edge-category tests fail.
labels.Lỗi thuật toán: The formula or method for the main computation is wrong, even when the code around it is fine: a wrong formula for an age, a power or a sum, a construction that always yields an empty or wrong structure, or a method that cannot solve the problem. A wrong condition or branch alone is not this error.
labels.Lỗi hard-code: Fixed values that should come from the input or the data file: a hard-coded file name or path, a fixed array size or record count instead of counting the records in the file, #include-ing the data file, special-casing test values, or printing an expected answer instead of computing it.
labels.Lỗi style: Code style problems: most or all of the solution submitted commented out, a needlessly long or convoluted function for what it does, heavy copy-paste, or names that hide the meaning. It can apply to an otherwise correct submission.
